title: Ukraine updates: Russian strikes kill several in Kyiv region
summary: Overnight attacks claimed the lives of civilians in the Kyiv region. Also, NATO is set to discuss Russian violations of Polish airspace. Follow live.

blocks.text: Below are the update on Russia's war in Ukraine on Monday, November 23:
UN urges probe after Russian ship attacked at Libyan port

blocks.caption: A satellite image shows huge plumes of smoke rising from a fire following an explosion aboard a Russian ship docked at the port of BenghaziImage: Planet Labs PBC/Handout/REUTERS

blocks.text: The United Nations on Monday called for an independent probe into suspected drone attacks on two ships off the coast of Libya, in what could be spillover from the war in Ukraine. One of the two vessels was Russian while the other was sailing under a Maltese flag.
The UN mission in Libya expressed "serious concern" over the attacks, calling for "an immediate, independent and transparent investigation".
"Libya cannot afford, and must not become a battleground for foreign conflicts," the UNSMIL wrote on X.
Libya's eastern administration did not identify who was behind Sunday's attack but said Libya was "not a party to the Russian-Ukrainian war".
